* [[Chen Shui-bian]] makes a televised address reiterating the [[Four Noes and One Without]] pledge and announcing the two questions for a referendum to coincide with the [[ROC presidential election, 2004]] on March 20.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://edition.cnn.com/2004/WORLD/asiapcf/01/16/taiwan.referendum.ap/index.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050906191952/http://edition.cnn.com/2004/WORLD/asiapcf/01/16/taiwan.referendum.ap/index.html |archive-date=2005-09-06 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www1.chinadaily.com.cn/en/doc/2004-01/17/content_299926.htm |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120206161159/http://www1.chinadaily.com.cn/en/doc/2004-01/17/content_299926.htm |archive-date=2012-02-06 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* U.S. President [[George W. Bush]] appoints [[Charles W. Pickering|Charles Pickering]] to the [[United States Court of Appeals]]. His nomination was [[filibuster]]ed in the [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]], so President Bush made a [[recess appointment]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://apnews.myway.com/article/20040116/D8044KNG0.html|title=My Way|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* [[Bam, Iran|Earthquake in Iran]]: Iran updates the death toll from the [[Bam, Iran|Bam]] earthquake to 41,000 people.  The final figure could be as high as 45,000.
* The People's Republic of China arrests a top Hong Kong official into custody over suspicion of espionage for the United Kingdom.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.ft.com/servlet/ContentServer?pagename=FT.com/StoryFT/FullStory&c=StoryFT&cid=1073281079666|title=Financial Times|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051128003129/http://news.ft.com/servlet/ContentServer?pagename=FT.com%2FStoryFT%2FFullStory|archive-date=28 November 2005|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* [[Nunavut general election, 2004]]: Premier [[Paul Okalik]] of [[Nunavut]], Canada, requests a dissolution of the territory's legislature and an election call for February 16.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://north.cbc.ca/regional/servlet/View?filename=nune-nominations |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051029191030/http://north.cbc.ca/regional/servlet/View?filename=nune-nominations |archive-date=2005-10-29 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* On or around this date, the [[U.S. public debt|United States national debt]] passes US$7 trillion.
